title: Is Instinct safe to use? Three things to know before you sign up

reading.body:
Instinct, an AI personal assistant, uses personal data to train its models by default, requiring users to opt out rather than opt in. This means sensitive information like browsing habits, location, and financial data can be used for model training without explicit authorization at the point of collection. A system designed with privacy as the default, or one that required affirmative consent before using personal data for training, would have prevented this failure mode.

The system also retains user data even after connected accounts are disconnected, making previously indexed information continue to be accessible. Instinct can make purchases on behalf of users, but liability for disputes falls to the user and merchant rather than to Instinct itself. What is not established is whether these practices violate any specific regulation, or whether users faced actual harm from the data retention or purchase authority.

summary:
# Summary

Instinct is a new AI personal assistant gaining popularity in Silicon Valley, but it presents significant privacy and security concerns. By default, Instinct uses personal information to train its AI models unless users opt out, which means sensitive data like browsing habits, location, and financial information can be used without direct authorization. Additionally, even when users disconnect connected accounts like Google, Instinct continues storing previously indexed data, so information remains accessible after disconnection. Finally, the assistant can make purchases on users' behalf, and disputes fall between the user and merchant rather than Instinct itself.

Norton argues that users should not sacrifice data privacy for AI convenience and promotes its alternative Norton Family Assistant as a more secure option. Unlike Instinct, Norton Family Assistant does not use shared information to train external AI models and requires explicit user confirmation before taking actions like submitting forms or making bookings. Norton emphasizes that users can easily delete their data and maintain control over their personal information while still benefiting from AI capabilities.
